summary.text: Jim Tomes is a Republican Indiana state senator who has represented District 49 since 2010 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as trucking Teamster and union steward.

paragraphs.text: Tomes graduated from Mater Dei High School, earned an associate degree from Ivy Tech, and served in the U.S. Army, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as a trucker and union steward.
Tomes first assumed office in the state Senate in 2010.

For the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Veterans Affairs and the Military Committee and is also assigned to the Agriculture, Homeland Security and Transportation, Senate Local Government, and Senate Natural Resources committees.
